The '''Lasay Swamp''' was a swamp region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Lasay Swamp is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
